mapper.select: select r.*, d.device_name as deviceName, d.device_code as deviceCode, d.status as deviceStatus, l.lab_name as labName, u.real_name as applicantName, h.real_name as handlerName from lab_device_repair r join lab_device d on d.id = r.device_id and d.deleted = 0 join lab l on l.id = r.lab_id and l.deleted = 0 left join sys_user u on u.id = r.applicant_user_id left join sys_user h on h.id = r.handler_user_id where r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into lab_device_repair( device_id, lab_id, applicant_user_id, issue_description, urgency_level, status, handler_user_id, handling_result, handled_at ) values ( #{deviceId}, #{labId}, #{applicantUserId}, #{issueDescription}, #{urgencyLevel}, #{status}, #{handlerUserId}, #{handlingResult}, #{handledAt} )
